      <div class="page-content">
        <h2 id="technical">Technical Program</h2>
        <p>
          The IEEE AFRICON 2027 technical program will feature a rich selection
          of peer-reviewed paper presentations organized into parallel technical
          sessions, keynote addresses, invited talks, workshops, and tutorials.
        </p>
        <p>
          The full technical program will be published after the paper
          acceptance notifications in July 2027. Check back for updates.
        </p>

        <h2 id="keynote" style="margin-top: 36px">Keynote Speakers</h2>
        <p>
          IEEE AFRICON 2027 will feature distinguished keynote speakers from
          academia, industry, and research institutions. Keynote speaker
          announcements will be made progressively. Visit the
          <a href="https://2027.ieee-africon.org/speakers/">Speakers page</a> for details.
        </p>

        <h2 id="workshops" style="margin-top: 36px">
          Workshops &amp; Tutorials
        </h2>
        <p>
          The Call for Workshops and Tutorials is open. Proposals should define
          the topic and learning outcomes, intended audience, format and
          duration, organizer and presenter biographies, anticipated attendance,
          required equipment and any proposed fees. Proposals will be reviewed
          for relevance, quality, feasibility and conflicts of interest.
        </p>
        <p>
          Use the <a href="https://2027.ieee-africon.org/contact-us/#message">conference contact form</a>
          and select <strong>Paper Submission</strong> to request proposal upload
          instructions. The final deadline and decision dates will be published after
          Steering Committee approval.
        </p>

        <h2 id="special-sessions" style="margin-top: 36px">
          Special Sessions, Panels &amp; Industry Programme
        </h2>
        <p>
          Proposals are invited for special technical sessions, moderated
          panels, industry sessions and IEEE Standards sessions. A proposal
          should identify the session type, title, rationale, organizer,
          prospective contributors, format, duration and any conflicts of
          interest. Commercial sponsorship does not influence speaker, paper or
          programme decisions. Use the
          <a href="https://2027.ieee-africon.org/contact-us/#message">conference contact form</a> and select
          <strong>Paper Submission</strong> to begin the process.
        </p>

        <h2 id="region8" style="margin-top: 36px">IEEE Region 8 Programme</h2>
        <p>
          Programme space is being coordinated with IEEE Region 8. Subject to
          confirmation, the programme may include Region 8 opening and
          leadership, Conference Coordination, Students and Young Professionals,
          Women in Engineering, Action for Industry, IEEE Standards, and an IEEE
          booth with member services. A Student Paper Contest is under
          consideration; no contest entries are being accepted until its rules,
          eligibility and judging process are confirmed.
        </p>
